owner: akiendelllinux_cc_0 (CC) gates writes. Akien's call, 2026-07-26: 'we're going to add a new step to some workflows: demo. DEMO goes on tickets I wanna watch work.'

questions.a: IT IS A GATE, NOT A STAGE — the ruling. A stage is where a node IS; a gate is what it must pass to move. Adding DEMO as a stage would mean editing every workflow path that could ever want it, and the emit-chokepoint would then refuse the paths that do not have it. As a gate it binds per-node with no path change at all, which is why it can be selective ('tickets I wanna watch work') without forking the class definitions.

PER-NODE OPT-IN IS THE GENUINELY NEW MECHANISM. Today a node's gate-set comes from its CLASS. DEMO is chosen at cast time for this node specifically. So what this actually builds is: a node may bind an EXTRA gate beyond its class's set. DEMO is the first user of that, and it will not be the last.

THE MACHINERY LANDED YESTERDAY AND THIS IS ITS SECOND TENANT. quorum.seal() (cairn fc6bfe2) already enforces distinct hands, refuses a signature carrying no `restated`, and records a red as a VERDICT that kicks back rather than an exception. validations_path_for_artifact gave a non-code artifact somewhere to be sealed. DEMO needs no new record shape — it is the same ratified eight fields through the same door.
